messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

They will tremble and be moved, for they know that their end must be changed.â€‌","verse":16},{"chapter":6,"text":"It happened that when I had heard it, I stood up on my feet, and listened, and, behold, there was a voice that spoke, and its sound was like the sound of many waters.","verse":17},{"chapter":6,"text":"It said, â€œBehold, the days come when I draw near to visit those who dwell upon the earth,","verse":18},{"chapter":6,"text":"and when I investigate those who have caused harm unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Zion is complete,","verse":19},{"chapter":6,"text":"and when the seal will be set on the age that is to pass away, then I will show these signs: the books will be opened before the firmament, and all will see together.","verse":20}],"book_code":"2ES"}
